stories.title: Inside Larry Fitzgerald's college career that could have, or should have, won him a Heisman
stories.summary: Ahead of Fitzgerald's induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, take a spin through his Pitt career.

stories.title: Every active NFL player who could make the Hall -- including 17 who could retire now
stories.summary: We went roster by roster to pick out the NFL players who are on track to make the Hall of Fame one day.

stories.title: Jorge Messi, the father of Lionel, dies at 68
stories.summary: Inter Miami and Argentina forward Lionel Messi's father, Jorge, has died at the age of 68, it was confirmed Saturday.

stories.title: Eagles will still 'lean into' Tush Push, new OC says
stories.summary: The Eagles will continue to "lean into" the tush push in their new offense, according to offensive coordinator Sean Mannion.

stories.title: Senate pushes college sports vote to September
stories.summary: The Protect College Sports Act failed to reach a vote during an all-night, pre-recess session in the Senate, though the bill did gain a spot on next month's calendar after the chamber comes back from its summer break.
